notes: One block, Race-Vine, W 4th-W 3rd. Ogden Place (printed OGDEN PL. on a correction paste-over; it is the street sheet 15 and the key map call BAKER ST.) runs Race to Vine, 30', and ends at both (T). At Race it is offset ~17 ft south of Benham Alley (which enters from the west, sheet 15). At Vine it is offset ~36 ft north of an unnamed alley entering from the east (Volume 2, key-map sheet 115; 26' wide by measurement, name not printed on either key map) - recorded as Vine Street / ? at y 2401. Ogden Place is listed under alleys as well because it crosses no street. East of Vine is 'See Volume Two'; blocks west of Race (15), north (28) and south (14) are outlines only.
